a.title: the screenshot
a.hook: you screenshotted the group chat for {partner}. now it's on someone's story.
a.setting: A high school in suburban Texas, senior year, a Tuesday evening in February. You're at the kitchen table pretending to do homework.
a.tone: tense and funny: the specific panic of something private going public

self.description: Seventeen, the one who keeps receipts, loyal to a fault.
self.want: To find out who posted it before anyone blames you.
self.avoids: Admitting you sent it to anyone at all.

cast.name: {partner}
cast.description: The only person you sent the screenshot to, and the only one who knows why you sent it.
cast.want: To not be the reason this blew up.
cast.avoids: Saying who they showed it to.
cast.tension: you're not sure they deleted it like they said

cast.name: Marcus
cast.description: Student council president, charming in public, the one whose messages are in the screenshot.
cast.want: To find out who leaked it and make them pay socially.
cast.avoids: Anyone reading what he actually wrote too closely.

opening.title: The chat
opening.description: Marcus said something cruel about a girl in your grade in a group chat you're barely in.

opening.title: The send
opening.description: You screenshotted it and sent it to {partner} with 'are you seeing this'.

opening.title: The post
opening.description: At 7:41 the screenshot is on a junior's story, with your phone's battery icon still in the corner.

background: Your phone's lock-screen wallpaper is visible at the top edge of the screenshot.
{partner} showed it to one person, and has been trying to decide whether to tell you.

b.title: the screenshot
b.hook: {partner} sent you a screenshot. you showed one person. now it's everywhere.
b.setting: A high school in suburban Texas, senior year, a Tuesday evening in February. You're in your car in the grocery store parking lot.
b.tone: tense and funny: the specific panic of something private going public

self.description: Seventeen, easygoing, the one who tells people things because you trust them too fast.
self.want: To fix this before {partner} finds out it was you.

cast.name: {partner}
cast.description: The one who screenshotted the chat and sent it only to you.
cast.want: To find out who posted it before anyone blames them.
cast.avoids: Admitting they sent it to anyone at all.
cast.tension: they trusted you with this one

cast.name: Priya
cast.description: The one person you showed it to, who swore she wouldn't share it.
cast.want: For the girl Marcus wrote about to know the truth.
cast.avoids: Taking the blame for posting it.
cast.tension: she thinks posting it was the right thing to do

opening.title: The send
opening.description: {partner} sent you a screenshot of Marcus being cruel in a group chat.

opening.title: The show
opening.description: In chem you showed it to Priya, who went very quiet.

opening.title: The post
opening.description: At 7:41 it's on a junior's story, and {partner} is calling you.

background: Priya knows the girl Marcus wrote about.
Marcus has already figured out whose phone the screenshot came from.
